name: MIP-Splatting
definition: An extension of 3DGS that introduces 2D and 3D Gaussian filters to improve robustness to aliasing caused by resolution changes, focal length variations, or camera distance changes.
summary: MIP-Splatting is a 3D Gaussian Splatting method that eliminates aliasing and dilation artifacts by using multi-scale representations and specific filters to constrain frequency to the Nyquist limit.
